format: C# ASP.NET Web Forms (CodeBehind for ShowAns.aspx)
description: This file is a code-behind class for an ASP.NET Web Forms page that displays and updates theory exam answers for students. It handles page load events, fetches student answers from a SQL database, and processes submissions to update marks.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Partial class for the ASP.NET page ShowAns.aspx, managing display and update of student's theory answers.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles loading the student's answers from the database for questions 1 through 5 when the page is loaded.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total marks from input, updates the database with student's marks, deletes the student from the course queue, and redirects to AdminCourseQueue.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user by redirecting to LoginPage.aspx.
